combinations.evidence_quote: Data showed that the co-administration of CoPP with HRW produced a greater analgesic effect than that made by both treatments administered separately and that only one day of treatment was enough to fully inhibit the nociceptive replies caused by CCI, as compared with the 3 or 4 days of treatment required by CoPP or HRW administered alone.
